review_candidates.title: Medical Interpreters Recruited ! (Remote Medical Interpreters) ! OPI and VRI ((Spanish-English))
review_candidates.description: Company Description Multilingual Interpreters and Translators is a language service and business solutions company headquartered in Winter Haven, Florida, with international operations across Egypt and many Latin American countries. The company focuses on delivering high-quality communication services in multiple languages while promoting cultural awareness and mutual respect between all parties. To support rapid growth and data protection, Multilingual has developed proprietary cloud-based platforms, including a Language Management System and a Multilingual Operations System, to manage global staff and language services. With hundreds of interpreters, translators, multilingual staff, and over 200 languages available, the company supports diverse projects and business solutions worldwide. Services are supported by a web-based training center and are available 24/7 throughout the year. Role Description This is a full-time remote role for Spanish-English Medical Interpreters providing Over-the-Phone (OPI) and Video Remote Interpreting (VRI) services. The Medical Interpreter will facilitate accurate and culturally sensitive communication between healthcare professionals and Spanish-speaking patients in a variety of medical settings. Daily tasks include interpreting medical consultations in real time, ensuring understanding of diagnoses and treatment plans, and maintaining strict confidentiality in line with privacy and data protection requirements. The role involves working with the company’s proprietary language management systems, following established protocols, and adhering to professional codes of ethics. Interpreters may also participate in ongoing training, collaborate with supervisors to improve service quality, and support operational efficiency across global teams. Qualifications Strong Medical Interpretation and Interpreting skills, with proven experience in Spanish-English medical settings. Proficiency in Medical Terminology related to common clinical, hospital, and specialty care scenarios. Ability to perform Simultaneous Interpretation and consecutive interpretation as required by OPI and VRI encounters. Competence in Translation of brief medical documents or patient instructions when needed. Fluent, native-level command of both Spanish and English, with clear and professional communication. Familiarity with remote interpreting platforms, call center or telehealth environments, and basic computer literacy. Knowledge of interpreter ethics, confidentiality standards, and regulations such as HIPAA or equivalent privacy frameworks. Prior experience in healthcare, medical interpreting, or language services; relevant certifications are a plus. Reliable internet connection, appropriate audio/video equipment, and a quiet, professional remote workspace. Strong listening skills, cultural sensitivity, emotional resilience, and the ability to remain impartial and composed.

Catering to a global market, they deliver seamless payment solutions to businesses worldwide, ensuring security and efficiency in every transaction. Role Overview Join our team as a Financial Manager focusing on Treasury and Settlement! This is an exciting opportunity to make a significant impact by managing complex financial operations and ensuring smooth transaction processes. Work fully remotely, collaborating with skilled professionals in a fast-paced and evolving industry. Key Responsibilities Manage daily liquidity across bank accounts, PSPs, EMIs, and other payment providers. Monitor available balances and forecast funding requirements to ensure smooth payment operations. Manage payout funding, ensuring sufficient liquidity is available across relevant accounts and payment providers. Initiate, control, and manage fund transfers between bank accounts, PSPs, and other payment partners. Handle FX operations, including currency conversions, exchange rates, and multi-currency fund management. Execute and oversee daily payment and settlement operations. Monitor payment flows and proactively identify potential liquidity or funding issues. Coordinate operational matters with banks, PSPs, EMIs, and other financial institutions. Support the development and optimization of treasury and settlement processes. Maintain accurate operational records and ensure transactions are executed correctly and on time. Requirements Hands-on experience in Treasury, Settlements or Payment Operations, preferably within FinTech, Payments, iGaming, Crypto, or other high-risk industries. Strong experience in liquidity management, payout funding, and fund movements. Experience managing transfers across banks, PSPs, EMIs, and payment providers. Practical knowledge of FX operations, multi-currency payments, and settlement flows. Experience working with multiple international banking and payment partners. Languages: English, Russian C1 Experience in fintech Key Soft Skills Strong attention to detail and accuracy when handling financial operations. Proactive and solution-oriented approach with the ability to identify and resolve operational issues. Strong ownership and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with multiple internal and external stakeholders. Ability to work independently while part of a remote team. Flexibility to adapt to changing priorities in a fast-paced environment. What We Offer Competitive salary aligned with experience Collaborative and transparent team culture High-impact role in a scaling fintech company Recognition of personal milestones and achievements Social benefits
